editors.notes: 217 integration detail pages from integrations-sitemap.xml read (bank card and travel pages 'integration-n2f-*' excluded). 191 are a generic template ('automate their accounting in X') with no mechanism, hence kind=unknown; only Sage (FR) and DATEV/eGecko/SAP (DE) pages have real content. Same software repeated per language page (fr/en/de/it) with country from site locale. Some pages are vendors, accounting firms or non-accounting tools (e.g. Wolters Kluwer, Septeo, In Extenso, Fiducial, Baker Tilly, Rydge Conseil, PayFit, Autodesk, Sellsy, Endered Solutions CSE). Listing pages load cards via JS load-more (first 100 visible); ES/de-CH listings show cards without links; NL and pt-BR listings empty in static HTML. No separate help center with accounting articles (FAQ pages are generic). Marketing claims '300+' integrations. Checked and not found publicly: Cegid Loop, Cegid Quadra (only 'Quadratus' on accountants page), Sage 50, Sage Generation Experts, Inqom, lexoffice name (only 'Lexware'), sevdesk, SAP Business One (only 'SAP'), Scopevisio, BuchhaltungsButler, Exact Online name (only 'Exact'), Octopus, WinBooks, Yuki, Sage BOB 50, Horus, Adsolut, ClearFacts, Business Central (only 'Microsoft Dynamics 365'), Sage Intacct.
